# Studio Nieto

> A get-up-and-go creative studio helping brands tell their story, thoughtfully and cleverly, on social media.

Studio Nieto is a social media creative studio based in Brooklyn, New York, founded and led by
Cristina Ramirez Nieto. With expertise in strategy and storytelling perfected among New York City
startups and an appreciation for balance nurtured in the Mediterranean, the studio is a
frantic-free constant for every type of client, across every type of project.

## Services

- Content Creation: attention-achieving visuals that represent your brand and build online community
- Strategy: a true-to-you blueprint, fine-tuned along the way, that outlasts any algorithm or platform
- Art Direction: imagery that is in harmony throughout, from top to bottom, start to finish
- Creator Partnerships: interesting people doing interesting things to move your brand forward
- IRL Experiences: intimate, utterly special events for your brand
- Video Production: concept, capture and edit videos for social media, tailored to each platform and audience
- UX Consulting: how the customer navigates, easily and enjoyably, the total experience
- Brand Identity: the look, feel and sound of the brand on social media

## Clients past and present

Everlane, nabr, Aerial, Bubble Skincare, Warby Parker, Microsoft.

## Just for fun

The studio runs @themodernchair on Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/themodernchair/), a side
project about furniture and interior design that grew organically into a community of over 25,000
design lovers.
